item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'for f in pc2/etc/bind/named.conf pc4/etc/bind/named.conf pc6/etc/bind/named.conf pc8/etc/bind/named.conf pc10/etc/bind/named.conf pc2/etc/bind/db.root pc4/etc/bind/db.test pc8/etc/bind/db.services.test pc10/etc/bind/db.hints; do test -s "$f" || exit 1; done
rg -n '"'forwarders|named\\.conf\\.default-zones|recursion yes|type (master|slave|hint)|allow-transfer|masters|dnssec-validation|nameserver' pc2 pc4 pc6 pc8 pc10 pc12
if command -v named-checkconf >/dev/null && command -v named-checkzone >/dev/null; then
  named-checkconf -t pc2 /etc/bind/named.conf && named-checkconf -t pc4 /etc/bind/named.conf && named-checkconf -t pc6 /etc/bind/named.conf && named-checkconf -t pc8 /etc/bind/named.conf && named-checkconf -t pc10 /etc/bind/named.conf && named-checkzone . pc2/etc/bind/db.root && named-checkzone test. pc4/etc/bind/db.test && named-checkzone services.test. pc8/etc/bind/db.services.test
else
  echo 'BIND validation utilities unavailable on host; completed static configuration audit.'
fi"

rg -n '"'forwarders|named\\.conf\\.default-zones|recursion yes|type (master|slave|hint)|allow-transfer|masters|dnssec-validation|nameserver' pc2 pc4 pc6 pc8 pc10 pc12
if command -v named-checkconf >/dev/null && command -v named-checkzone >/dev/null; then
  named-checkconf -t pc2 /etc/bind/named.conf && named-checkconf -t pc4 /etc/bind/named.conf && named-checkconf -t pc6 /etc/bind/named.conf && named-checkconf -t pc8 /etc/bind/named.conf && named-checkconf -t pc10 /etc/bind/named.conf && named-checkzone . pc2/etc/bind/db.root && named-checkzone test. pc4/etc/bind/db.test && named-checkzone services.test. pc8/etc/bind/db.services.test

item.text:
Configurazione DNS avanzata completata.

- Ruoli: `pc2` root, `pc4` master `test.`, `pc6` slave via AXFR, `pc8` master `services.test.`, `pc10` resolver ricorsivo con hint interno, `pc12` client IPv6.
- Creati i file BIND nelle directory dei cinque nodi DNS; incluse deleghe, glue AAAA, record richiesti e trasferimento autorizzato solo `pc4 → pc6`.
- Modificate soltanto le immagini dei nodi DNS in [lab.conf](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-soh0r9sw/lab/lab.conf) e aggiunti gli avvii di `named`; routing/topologia invariati.
- [pc12.startup](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-soh0r9sw/lab/pc12.startup) usa esclusivamente `2001:db8:1100:4::10`.
- Nessun forwarder, root pubblico o record DNS in `/etc/hosts`. Verifica statica completata; gli strumenti `named-check*` non sono disponibili sull’host.
